therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: active immunization / antibody induction against Aβ
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: amyloid plaque clearance / reduction of amyloid burden
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: adults with mild to moderate Alzheimer's disease
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Percentage of participants with treatment-emergent AEs or SAEs over approximately 110 weeks

results.effect_size: AE rates: 83.3–100% across arms; SAE rates: 11.4–41.7% across arms
results.target_engagement_evidence: Anti-Aβ IgG GMTs rose substantially in ACC-001+QS-21 arms (e.g., up to ~7642 U/mL at Week 56 for 30 μg+QS-21 vs baseline 50 U/mL); minimal response in ACC-001 alone arms; no response in QS-21 alone or PBS arms
biomarker_changes: Anti-Aβ IgG GMTs markedly elevated in ACC-001+QS-21 arms across all timepoints through Week 104
Anti-Aβ IgM GMTs also elevated in ACC-001+QS-21 arms, with highest titers at Week 16 (ACC 30 μg+QS-21: 5666 U/mL)
ACC-001 without QS-21 produced modest IgG and IgM responses above baseline
QS-21 alone and PBS showed no meaningful antibody response
IgG subtype analysis was not performed
subgroup_findings: ACC-001+QS-21 arms showed dose-dependent increases in anti-Aβ IgG and IgM titers
ACC 30 μg+QS-21 had highest SAE rate at 17.5%; ACC 30 μg alone had highest SAE rate of 41.7%
Vasogenic cerebral oedema reported in ACC 30 μg+QS-21 (1/40) and ACC 10 μg (1/35) arms
safety_signals: Vasogenic cerebral oedema in ACC 30 μg+QS-21 (1/40) and ACC 10 μg (1/35)
Cerebrovascular accident in ACC 30 μg alone (1/12)
SAE rate notably high in ACC 30 μg alone arm (41.7%)
Overall AE rates high across all arms (83–100%)

dose_info.dose: ACC-001: 3 μg, 10 μg, or 30 μg; QS-21: 50 μg
dose_info.schedule: IM injection at Day 1 and Weeks 4, 12, 26, and 52

context.comparator: QS-21 alone and phosphate buffered saline (diluent)
context.duration: 110 weeks (6-week screening, 52 weeks dosing, 54 weeks follow-up)

modulation_entries.hypothesis: QS-21 acts as an adjuvant that potentiates the humoral immune response to ACC-001 antigen, substantially increasing anti-Aβ IgG and IgM titers compared to ACC-001 alone
modulation_entries.citation: ACC-001+QS-21 arms showed markedly higher anti-Aβ IgG GMTs (e.g., up to ~7642 U/mL at Week 56 for 30 μg+QS-21) compared to ACC-001 alone arms (463.7 U/mL at Week 56 for 30 μg), while QS-21 alone produced no antibody response above baseline
